about: Hand-made corrections applied on top of the pulled source data by source/playground/elements.weave. Each one names the value it replaces; if the source no longer has that value (e.g. after re-running script/pull-elements), the build fails so the correction can be reviewed rather than silently overriding new upstream data.

pubchem.reason: Alum was known in antiquity, but aluminium itself was first isolated by Hans Christian Ørsted in 1825. PubChem dates comparable elements (Na, K, Mg) by isolation.
Lime was known in antiquity, but calcium itself was first isolated by Humphry Davy in 1808. PubChem dates comparable elements (Na, K, Mg) by isolation.
